features.name: tabletop playing board
features.notes: Tabletop-scale board visible in one view
features.quote: A tabletop-scale grid or board that players act on rather than move through

features.name: evenly divided board spaces
features.notes: Grid of evenly divided squares or spaces
features.quote: grid of evenly divided squares or spaces that pieces move across

features.name: tiered resource hexes
features.notes: Three to four production tiers per resource type with rare tiers less common
features.quote: Suggest 3-4 tiers per resource type (e.g., Low/Medium/High/Rare), with rare tiers noticeably rarer on the board

features.name: variable hex heights glows
features.notes: Higher-output hexes visibly taller or brighter
features.quote: hex size/height, glow intensity, or particle density scales with output rate

features.name: resource terrain types
features.notes: Distinct resource types across the hex board
features.quote: each hex's tier/resource type set at map generation

features.name: settlement pieces
features.notes: Placed adjacent to touching resource hexes
features.quote: settlements/cities collect from all touching hexes

features.name: city pieces
features.quote: players build roads, settlements, and cities

features.name: connecting road pieces
features.quote: players build roads, settlements, and cities

features.name: robber marker
features.notes: Distinct movable board piece on an opponent adjacent hex
features.quote: move it onto an opponent's adjacent hex

features.name: live resource HUD
features.notes: Persistent display of resource counts and board state
features.quote: Basic HUD showing live resource counts and board state
